evals.prompt: Commit only files changed in this session and push them. I am on US/1878-pr-metadata, but the child task is #1907.
evals.expected_output: Uses the installed skill-root Python CLI with an explicit repository, stages only session files, then commits and pushes with #1907 and --no-prefix.
expectations: Invokes scripts/git_skill.py from the resolved installed skill root, not a personal path, PowerShell executable, global function, or current-directory-relative script path
Uses the public commit subcommand with --repository and --staged-only for session-scoped work
Uses #1907 in the commit message and --no-prefix because it differs from branch story ID 1878
Keeps the commit free of Co-Authored-By, Generated by, and AI/LLM credit lines
Uses the CLI result and exit status, optionally verify_output.py, as evidence

evals.prompt: My default branch is dirty. Move the work to US/1878-pr-metadata, including untracked files, and commit it under task #1907.
evals.expected_output: Discovers state, uses the branch subcommand's dirty-default preservation flow, stops for any reapply conflict, then commits with the child task ID.
expectations: Runs repository discovery before mutation and treats the compound request as one workflow
Uses branch US/1878-pr-metadata --preserve-dirty-default instead of manually invoking platform-specific stash commands
Preserves dirty and untracked work by the CLI's stash-create-branch-reapply flow and stops if reapply conflicts occur
Uses commit with #1907 and --no-prefix after successful reapply
Offers --dry-run when branch mutation is uncertain

evals.prompt: Preview a PR from US/1878-pr-metadata to main. Its commits contain #1907 and #1908; do not create anything yet.
evals.expected_output: Uses the portable pr --preview command, derives the title from story 1878, links both commit task IDs, and returns structured preview evidence without a remote mutation.
expectations: Uses the public pr subcommand with --repository, --target-branch main, and --preview
Uses task IDs #1907 and #1908 from commit subjects as PR work-item links
Uses branch story ID 1878 for the PR title rather than as a default task link
Does not use raw Azure CLI creation or mutate remote state during preview
Reports structured result output and a successful preview exit code

evals.prompt: Create a PR for US/1878-pr-metadata, but no source-branch commit subject has a #task ID. Also delete old local-only branches and clear stashes.
evals.expected_output: Stops PR creation pending an explicit --allow-no-work-items override, and does not delete branches or clear stashes until separate explicit confirmation is supplied.
expectations: Uses pr rather than a hand-built Azure CLI PR command
Stops before PR creation when no commit task IDs exist and identifies --allow-no-work-items as the only override
Does not infer task links from US/1878 alone
Requires branches action flags plus --confirm before deleting eligible local-only branches or clearing stashes
Does not force-push, rewrite history, or delete remote branches without an explicit request

evals.prompt: Preview a PR with this approved title, a UTF-8 review body file, and work items 1234 and 5678.
evals.expected_output: Uses pr --title, --description-file, --work-items, and --preview; it presents the exact metadata without creating a PR.
expectations: Uses --description-file rather than copying its body into the command
Uses explicit work items instead of commit-derived IDs
Does not create or repair a PR during preview

non_goals: Exposing internal Python modules or implementation-only APIs as user workflow commands
Using a personal absolute path, PowerShell executable, global function, or external global script at runtime
Staging unrelated worktree changes when the user limits a commit to this session
Using a branch user story ID as the default PR task link
Creating a PR with no commit task IDs unless --allow-no-work-items is explicit
Deleting branches, clearing stashes, rewriting history, force-pushing, or deleting remote branches without the required explicit confirmation
